entities.summary: Aleksandrów Łódzki ( ) is a town in Zgierz County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland. It is a part of the Łódź metropolitan area. Aleksandrów Łódzki has an area of 13.82 square kilometres, and as of June 2022 its population was 22,160.
